canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group, Corporation denied {value} of its 2,534 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group, Corporation decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group, Corporation will deny any specific future application with 7.0% probability
Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group, Corporation is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group, Corporation discriminates or violates law
7.0% applies to Gold Star Mortgage Financial Group, Corporation's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
